modules.name: Apprentice Mode (first games)
modules.note: Half the arena, equal Mages, preset spellbooks.

steps.note: Apprentice Mode: use only half of it (2 by 3 zones)

steps.text: Each player picks a Mage: Mage card and Ability card
Each player picks a Mage card (suggested: Warlock and Beastmaster); no Ability cards
Each player picks red or blue: 10 action markers, 3 black and 1 red status cube, 1 black quickcast marker
Mage card in the corner zone nearest you (door symbol), with an action marker and the quickcast marker white side up
Mage status board: black cubes on the Mage's Channeling, Mana Supply 10 and Life; red cube on Life damage 0
Apprentice values for every Mage: Channeling 10, Life 24, melee attack 3 dice
Fill the spellbook from your Mage's preset deck, in order up to the Ability card (one card per pocket)
Dice, condition markers and other markers in reach
The initiative marker passes to the other player every round
Each round add your Channeling to your mana
Planning: secretly choose up to 2 spells each round; only those can be cast that round
Both roll the d12; the higher roller decides who takes the initiative marker and acts first
